title: What If #29 Marvel 1991 Captain America Had Formed the Avengers Reading Copy
conditionDescription: Reading copy: creasing, a spine split and staple wear on the front, edge wear and a stain at the top right of the back cover. See photos.
descriptionText:
What If...? #29 (September 1991), Marvel Comics - What if Captain America had formed the Avengers? 50 Years of Captain America corner box. $1.25 cover price.

Back cover: Marvel Universe Series II trading cards (Impel) ad.

Condition: reading copy - creasing, a small spine split and staple wear on the front, edge wear and a small stain at the top right of the back cover (see photos). Priced accordingly.

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
